summary: Sync folders between your computer and your Kobo with Syncthing. Needs your computer.
page_description: Sync notes, photos and books from your computer to your Kobo with Syncthing. Sync when you tap Sync now, or on a schedule while Cobalt is open on Wi-Fi.
release_notes: Sync is one switch at the top of the screen that says whether files are moving or paused, and the schedule is picked from a list. The status screen keeps every fact on the panel after a sync brings files in.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already. Sync also needs Syncthing on this computer, installed with its package manager.
With the reader awake on Wi-Fi, pair one folder on this computer with a folder on the reader. The first time, the reader downloads the Syncthing engine.
Start this computer's side of Sync and leave it running.
On the reader, open Sync and tap Turn on Sync. The first sync starts at once and takes up to five minutes.
